reasons: The original clause selects Nova Scotia law and Nova Scotia courts — the counterparty's home jurisdiction, outside the accepted set (NY, DE, CA, England & Wales) — so the 'deviation' status is correct.

The redline implements the preferred position exactly: New York governing law and exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, while preserving the surrounding sentence structure (the two-sentence governing-law/forum construction) as the redline guidance requires.
Shifting 'non-exclusive' to 'exclusive' is directionally correct and expressly contemplated by the preferred position, not an over-reach.
The comment is accurate, appropriately concise, uses the required prefix and first-person plural, states what changed and why, and offers the Delaware/California/England & Wales fallback.
The 0.504 changed-character ratio is expected here because both the law and the forum sentence had to be replaced; no unnecessary substantive terms were altered.
